{"code_snippet":"# measurement script to time sum(range(1, 10_000_001)) five independent runs
import time
import sys
import platform
import datetime
import statistics

EXPECTED = 50000005000000

measurement_code = '''\nfrom time import perf_counter\ns = sum(range(1, 10_000_001))\n# one timed run shown; the actual script runs this five times independently\n'''

def run_measurement():
    times = []
    computed = None
    out_lines = []
    out_lines.append('Starting measurement: sum(range(1, 10_000_001))')
    for i in range(1, 6):
        start = time.perf_counter()
        s = sum(range(1, 10_000_001))
        end = time.perf_counter()
        elapsed = end - start
        times.append(elapsed)
        computed = s
        out_lines.append(f'Run {i}: elapsed={elapsed:.9f} sec, sum={s}')
    py_ver = platform.python_version() + ' (' + sys.version.splitlines()[0] + ')'
    ts = datetime.datetime.now().isoformat()
    out_lines.append('')
    out_lines.append('Python version: ' + py_ver)
    out_lines.append('Timestamp: ' + ts)
    out_lines.append('Expected sum: ' + str(EXPECTED))
    out_lines.append('Verified equal: ' + str(computed == EXPECTED))
    out_lines.append('')
    out_lines.append('Measurement code used:')
    out_lines.append(measurement_code)
    out_lines.append('')
    out_lines.append('Summary statistics:')
    out_lines.append('times: ' + str(times))
    out_lines.append('mean: ' + str(statistics.mean(times)))
    out_lines.append('median: ' + str(statistics.median(times)))
    out_lines.append('min: ' + str(min(times)))
    out_lines.append('max: ' + str(max(times)))
    return {'times': times, 'mean': statistics.mean(times), 'median': statistics.median(times), 'min': min(times), 'max': max(times), 'python_version': py_ver, 'timestamp': ts, 'verified_sum': computed, 'output': '\n'.join(out_lines), 'measurement_code': measurement_code}

if __name__ == '__main__':
    result = run_measurement()
    print(result['output'])
"}
